lecciones

  • Numbers, people, and core wordsConnect the first N5 signs with simple words and sentences.
  • Books, space, time, and movementRead simple words about books, inside space, time, and movement.
  • Months, order, life, and positionUnderstand the time chain: month, minutes, before/after, up, and interval.
  • Money, school, height, and eastUse kanji in short phrases about school, price, and direction.
  • Children, outside space, down, and moodRead basic phrases about children, money, place, and state.
  • Size, mountain, talk, women, north, and countingConnect kanji for people, directions, time, and simple counting.
  • Writing, names, water, rivers, and halfRead words about names, writing, water, numbers, and people.
  • West, electricity, school, language, and foodBuild school and daily-life words into short N5 sentences.
  • Transport, questions, south, every day, and skyPractice questions, directions, weather, and frequency.
  • Family, sides, reading, rest, and weatherLock in the final N5 kanji through family, sides, and actions.
